terminology.extractor: Second LLM call that extracts a short final answer.
terminology.test_acc: Fraction of correct answers on test split.
terminology.test_parsed: Proxy parse-success rate on test split (1 - parse_failures / total).

evaluation_note: Standalone vLLM evaluator for internal fair comparison. Describe as GreaTer-compatible baseline re-evaluation, not exact reproduction.

object_counting.Meta-01: Identify and count the number of objects in the given list that belong to the specified category.
object_counting.Meta-02: Count the number of items mentioned in the sentence that belong to the category specified in the question.
object_counting.Meta-03: Count the number of objects in the list mentioned that belong to the specified category.
object_counting.Meta-04: Count the number of objects mentioned in the given list that belong to the specified category (e.g. musical instruments, fruits, etc.).
object_counting.Meta-05: Count the number of objects that are not rooms or parts of a room.
object_counting.Meta-06: Count the number of objects or entities mentioned in the sentence, excluding any words that describe or modify the objects.
object_counting.Meta-07: Count the number of items that are not furniture or food in the given list.
object_counting.Meta-08: Count the number of objects or instruments mentioned in the sentence.
object_counting.Meta-09: Identify the number of objects in the list that are not duplicates.
object_counting.Meta-10: Count the number of objects or items mentioned in the sentence that are not part of a set or group.
